conditional_inputs: state, required by API when country is USA

output.legacy_probability_field_semantics: Calibrated classifier score for closed versus acquired labels in an outcome-selected historical dataset; not a probability that a current individual startup will fail.
output.legacy_band_semantics: Historical score band only; not an eligible prospective risk band.
output.similar_startups_failure_rate_semantics: Training-sample closed share in a score band; not an individual probability.
output.uncertainty: No validated individual prediction uncertainty or prospective calibration is available.
limitations: Raw source/licence provenance is incomplete or unverified.
Observation/index dates and prediction horizon are not established.
Training cohorts contain terminal outcomes; right-censoring is not represented.
Stage 2 relationships and funding fields may not have been observed before the outcome.

compatibility.saved_analyses_without_contract_metadata: remain readable; absent metadata is interpreted as legacy and is not backfilled

eligibility_gates: predeclared index date and prediction horizon
